app.name: Family Food Intelligence
app.tagline: Know what your family is buying
activity.heading: Activity
activity.signInRequired: Sign in to see your recent product activity.
activity.empty: Your recent product activity will appear here.
activity.sentenceBoughtNeither: You decided not to buy either
verdict.EVERYDAY.meaning: Fits the goals you have set, as a regular choice.
verdict.OCCASIONAL.meaning: Fine sometimes. Not a staple for this person.
verdict.LIMIT.meaning: Works against a goal you have set. The reason is named below.
verdict.DOESNT_FIT.meaning: Conflicts with a preference or restriction you recorded.
verdict.INSUFFICIENT_DATA.meaning: We do not have enough verified information about this product to give a result. We would rather say nothing than guess.
allergen.heading: Contains {allergen}
allergen.body: This is what the manufacturer declares on the label. Manufacturing cross-contamination is not covered by the declaration.
score.title: How this was assessed
score.explainer: A product-level reading of the nutrition panel, separate from how it fits any one person. It is one input, not the answer.
score.notYetScored: Not yet scored. No reviewed nutrition standard is active yet — we would rather say nothing than guess.
product.servingImplausible: This declared serving is smaller than usual for this category, so the per-serving numbers look lower than a realistic portion.
product.reformulated: The label changed on {date}. You are seeing the current version.
product.dataNeedsVerification: Our sources disagree on part of this label, so we have not published a result for it yet.
product.openFoodFactsAttribution: Product data from Open Food Facts (Open Database License)
fit.heading: For your family
fit.signInPrompt: Sign in to see how this fits the people in your household
fit.signInReason: A personal result is worked out from the goals and allergens you record. That information belongs to an account, so we ask you to sign in before we create it.
fit.noMembers: Add yourself to your household to see a personal result.
fit.comingSoon: Personalised results for each person are coming soon. For now, use the nutrition panel below.
fit.consentRequired: You have not yet agreed to personal food suitability. Turn it on in Settings to see results for yourself.
fit.childConsentRequired: A guardian needs to complete consent before we work out results for this child. Until then we process nothing for them.
fit.consentWithdrawn: You turned this off. Turn it back on in Settings to see a result for yourself.
fit.noProfileFor: {name} has not set up a profile yet.
why.heading: Why this result
why.noRules: No rule applied for this person, so we are showing general nutrition information only.
why.noGoals: No goals are set for this person yet, so no rule applies.
why.missingData: We do not have {nutrient} on file for this product, so it could not be checked.
alternatives.heading: Better options
alternatives.empty: We do not have a better option in this category yet. We would rather show nothing than pad the list.
compare.heading: Compare
compare.basisNote: Compared per 100 g so the products line up.
compare.searchPrompt: Search for a product to compare against
compare.startFromProduct: Pick a product first, then compare it against another.
outcome.heading: Did you buy it?
outcome.thanks: Thanks — that helps us know whether this is useful.
outcome.signInPrompt: Sign in to record what you decided.
search.empty: Search for a packaged food product to get started.
search.noResults: We do not have this product yet.
search.noResultsAction: Photograph the nutrition label and we will read it for you.
scan.heading: Scan a barcode
scan.hint: Point the camera at the barcode on the pack.
scan.permissionDenied: We do not have camera access. You can still search by name, or type the barcode.
scan.notSupported: This browser cannot use the camera for scanning. Search by name instead.
scan.notFound: We do not have this barcode yet.
scan.ambiguous: This barcode matches more than one product in our data. Please pick the right one.
capture.heading: Photograph the label
capture.hint: Fill the frame with the nutrition panel. Good light helps.
capture.unreadable: We could not read that image. Try again with more light and the panel flat.
capture.confirmBody: We read these from your photo. Please correct anything that is wrong — we will not produce a result until you confirm.
capture.lowConfidence: We are unsure about this one. Please check it.
capture.contribute: Also add this product to the shared catalogue
capture.unavailable: Label capture will be available once the secure label-reading service is connected. Until then, search by name or use the barcode on the pack.
contribute.heading: Add this product
contribute.explainer: Your contribution helps improve the shared catalogue for every household. We ask for the product's name, pack size and nutrition panel, and a person checks it before it appears in search.
contribute.servingDeclaredLabel: Serving size, as declared on the pack
contribute.nutrientsServingOptional: Optional — fill in if the pack declares it
contribute.ingredientsLabel: Ingredients, as listed on the pack
contribute.acknowledgeFallback: I confirm this information is accurate and agree it may be reviewed and added to the shared catalogue.
contribute.successBody: We will check this before it appears for other households. This can take a few days.
ops.approveSuccess: Approved. A real catalogue product now exists for this.
household.heading: Your household
household.createExplainer: A household lets you see how one product fits different people.
household.inviteExplainer: We will send them an invitation. They set up their own account and make their own privacy choices — you cannot do that on their behalf.
household.addChildExplainer: A guardian manages a child's profile. We store an age band, allergens and dietary preferences — nothing more — and only after you complete consent.
household.soloIsFine: A household of one works exactly the same way.
profile.heading: Your profile
profile.ageBandExplainer: An age band, not a date of birth. It is all a rule needs.
profile.goalsExplainer: Pick what matters to you. This is what your results are based on.
profile.conditions: Anything you would like us to take into account
medical.notice: This is food information, not medical advice. It does not replace a conversation with a qualified healthcare professional.
medical.conditionNotice: We use what you record here to adjust which reference points apply. We do not diagnose anything, and we will not set a target for you.
medical.excludedPopulation: For this situation we show general nutrition information only. Please talk to a qualified healthcare professional about what is right for you.
consent.heading: Your privacy choices
consent.withdrawEffect: We stop processing for this purpose straight away.
consent.childPending: Consent not yet completed. Nothing is being processed for this child.
consent.guardianAttestation: I am this child's parent or legal guardian and I agree to the purpose described above.
consent.guardianAttestationNote: This consent mechanism is under legal review and is not yet approved for a live launch.
privacy.exportExplainer: A copy of your households, profiles, consent history and product contributions, as a file you can keep.
privacy.deleteExplainer: We remove your profile, your results and your activity. We keep a record that you gave and withdrew consent, and a record that the deletion happened.
privacy.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. There is no way to cancel once you confirm.
privacy.deleteSuccess: Your account will be permanently erased. You have been signed out.
privacy.deleteChildConfirm: Erase {name}'s data? This removes their profile and cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteChildSuccess: This child's data has been erased.
privacy.otherMembersUnaffected: Other people in your household keep their own profiles and results.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Length matters more than symbols.

search.allLoaded: That is every product we have in this list.

compare.differentCategories: These are different kinds of food, so a per-100 g comparison only tells you so much.
compare.fitUnavailable: We could not work this out just now.
consent.needsHouseholdTitle: Your privacy choices appear once you have a household
consent.needsHouseholdBody: Consent is recorded for each person separately, so we need to know who is in your household before we can ask.
settings.forgotPasswordHelp: Password reset is not available yet. Please contact support to recover an account.
settings.signOutConfirmBody: Your household and profiles stay exactly as they are. You can sign back in at any time.
household.watchingForChildHelp: Pick what matters. This is what {name}'s results are based on.
product.noPerServingDeclared: This label does not declare a per-serving amount, so only per-100 figures are shown.
legal.privacyLede: What this app records about your household, why, and what you can do about it. Everything below describes how the app behaves today.
legal.purposesBody: We ask separately for each purpose, and record each answer against the person it concerns. You can turn any non-essential purpose off at any time in Settings, and we stop processing for it straight away.
legal.purposesUnavailable: We could not load the current purposes. They are also listed in Settings under Your privacy choices.
legal.childrenBody: A child's profile is managed by a guardian, who must confirm their relationship and the basis of their authority before a profile is created. For a child we store an age band, allergens and dietary preferences — never a date of birth, and nothing else. We work out results for a child only after a guardian has completed consent for that child.
legal.rightsBody: All three of these are available from Settings, without contacting us.
legal.rightExport: Download a copy of your households, profiles, consent history and contributions as a file.
legal.rightWithdraw: Turn off any non-essential purpose. We stop processing for it immediately.
legal.rightDelete: Delete your account. We remove your profile, your results and your activity, and keep only a record that consent was given and withdrawn and that the deletion happened.
legal.sourcesBody: Product information is drawn from Open Food Facts under the Open Database License and from labels contributed by people using this app. Contributed product data is about the product, not about you, and carries no personal information.
legal.reviewNotice: This notice describes the software's current behaviour and has not yet completed legal review. It is not the final published notice.
legal.termsLede: The short version of what this app is, and what it is not.
legal.termsWhatBody: Information about packaged food products, and how a product compares against goals and allergens you record for the people in your household. It reports what a label declares and explains its reasoning.
legal.termsAccuracyBody: The catalogue is assembled from open data and contributions, so it can be incomplete or out of date, and a manufacturer can reformulate a product at any time. Always read the pack itself before relying on a result, and tell us when something looks wrong.
legal.termsAccountBody: Keep your password to yourself. Records you create for other adults are invitations only — each adult sets up their own account and makes their own privacy choices.
legal.termsContributionsBody: A product you add is reviewed before it appears for other households. Contribute only photographs of product packaging that you took yourself.
auth.legalAgreement: By creating an account you agree to:
profile.childConsentTitle: Complete consent before we record anything
profile.childConsentBody: We do not store an age band, allergens or dietary preferences for {name} until a guardian has given consent for them. You can do that under Your privacy choices in Settings.
profile.childConsentRequired: A guardian needs to complete consent for this child before we can save a profile.
overview.heading: How your household is set up
overview.allReady: All {count} people can get a personal result
overview.allReadySub: Everyone has a profile and has given consent, so each product page shows a result for each of them.
overview.someReady: {ready} of {total} people can get a personal result
overview.someReadySub: The rest are missing something below. Until then, their product pages show general nutrition information only.
overview.blockerChildConsent: {name} needs a guardian to complete consent.
overview.blockerSelfConsent: {name} has not turned on personal food suitability yet.
overview.blockerNoProfile: {name} has no profile yet — we need an age band at minimum.
overview.watchingEmpty: Nothing recorded yet. What each person is watching comes from their profile.
overview.allergensHeading: Allergens to avoid across the household
overview.allergensEmpty: No allergens recorded for anyone in this household.
overview.allergensNote: From the profiles you have recorded. We flag these on a product when its label declares them — always read the pack too.
error.metric_not_permitted_for_age: We do not record this measurement for children. This is a deliberate choice about children's data, not a limit on your account.
error.profile_required_for_metric: We need an age band on this person's profile before recording this measurement.
today.heading: How you are doing today
today.lede: Everything here comes from what you have actually recorded. Where nothing is logged, we say so rather than showing a zero.
today.signInPrompt: Sign in to track your own day. Your records are yours — nobody else in your household sees them unless you share a category.
today.needsHousehold: Create your household to start tracking. A household of one works exactly the same way.
today.profileNote: Add an age band to your profile so we know which measurements apply to you.
quicklog.noneAvailable: Nothing to log here yet. Measurements available for a person depend on their age band.
insight.notEnoughYet: Not enough recorded yet to call this a trend.
